tools.name: search_creators
tools.description: Search B2B creators by words, topic and LinkedIn follower range. Returns a verdict and fit notes for each. Call list_topics for valid topic ids.

tools.name: get_creator
tools.description: Get one creator by id: ideas, takeaways, brands, fit, partnership options and similar creators.

tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Find brands discussed by B2B creators, with counts of disclosed deals and organic mentions.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Get the creators linked to a brand, grouped by disclosed deals, partners, customers, organic mentions and insiders, each with a quote and post link. Use to find who to approach.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Find active B2B newsletters and podcasts: what each covers, who it suits, and sponsors found in recent issues with quotes. Podcasts include a Podscan audience estimate where matched; prices are not available.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List topic ids with creator counts.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_brand, search_publications · Public sink: get_brand.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_brand, search_publications · Public sink: get_brand

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
